scope: Unchanged-math isolated vision event profile after complete actual activation/shadow A/B. Three clean/profile/clean calls per mode; no per-op synchronization. Parent vision event is inclusive and never added to child sums. Complete wall includes encode_ids CPUoutput and excludes extra proof/event-readback plus upstreamHTTPprocessor/broadcast/load/offload.

representative.note: Parent contains children and is NOT added to their sum. Device events include dependencies/host gaps/stalls; host intervals are not additive with device events. Remainder is unassigned, not clamped.
